question: Did Box's fiscal Q2 2027 (quarter ended July 31, 2026) revenue, non-GAAP operating margin and GAAP EPS come in above or below the company's own guidance from its fiscal Q1 2027 earnings release in May 2026?
grading: Key points: (1) revenue USD 321.1M vs guidance of about USD 319M = ABOVE (+0.7%); (2) non-GAAP operating margin 29.4% vs about 28.5% = ABOVE; (3) GAAP EPS USD 0.09 vs about USD 0.11 = BELOW (FX impact cited); optional: non-GAAP EPS USD 0.40 vs about USD 0.39 = slightly above; GAAP operating margin 10.2% vs about 10.0% = above. Benchmark must be company guidance (May 26, 2026), which Box gives as point estimates ('approximately'). Fail if GAAP EPS is called a beat or the quarter is described as beating on every metric.
answer: Against the Q2 FY27 guidance in the May 26, 2026 release [H18-E1], Box's results for the quarter ended July 31, 2026 [H18-E2][H18-E3] were: revenue USD 321.1 million vs about USD 319 million = above (+0.7%); non-GAAP operating margin 29.4% vs about 28.5% = above; GAAP EPS USD 0.09 vs about USD 0.11 = BELOW (the company cited a USD 0.04 FX headwind). Also: non-GAAP EPS USD 0.40 vs about USD 0.39 (above) and GAAP operating margin 10.2% vs about 10.0% (above).

output.answer:
## Box fiscal Q2 2027 (quarter ended July 31, 2026) vs. company guidance

**Verdict: Revenue — above. Non-GAAP operating margin — above. GAAP EPS — below.**

Box reported Q2 FY27 results on **August 25, 2026**, against the Q2 outlook it issued with its **May 26, 2026** Q1 FY27 release:

| Metric | May 2026 guidance | Q2 FY27 actual | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| Revenue | ~$319 million | **$321.1 million** (+9% YoY, +11% cc) | **Above** |
| Non-GAAP operating margin | ~28.5% | **29.4%** (record; op. income $94.5M) | **Above** |
| GAAP operating margin | ~10.0% | 10.2% | Above |
| GAAP diluted EPS | ~$0.11 | **$0.09** | **Below** |

Key points worth flagging:

- **Revenue and margin both exceeded guidance.** Management explicitly said "revenue, billings, and operating margin all exceeding our expectations," with RPO of $1.7B (+15%) and billings of $309.5M (+17%).
- **GAAP EPS fell short of the company's own guide ($0.09 vs. ~$0.11).** The miss was driven by FX: the actual quarter carried **$0.04 of unfavorable currency impact**, versus the ~$0.03 FX headwind baked into guidance. On a constant-currency basis, guidance was ~$0.14, so the gap is largely a currency-translation story rather than an operational one.
- **Non-GAAP EPS was a modest beat:** $0.40 vs. the guided ~$0.39.
- Note the GAAP/non-GAAP divergence is structural for Box — roughly 19 points of margin is stock-based compensation ($61.4M, ~19% of revenue in Q2).

**Sources:**
- Box Reports Second Quarter Fiscal 2027 Financial Results (Aug 25, 2026): https://www.boxinvestorrelations.com/news-and-media/news/press-release-details/2026/Box-Reports-Second-Quarter-Fiscal-2027-Financial-Results
- Box Reports First Quarter Fiscal 2027 Financial Results / Q2 FY27 guidance (May 26, 2026), SEC EX-99.1: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1372612/000119312526239239/box-ex99_1.htm
- Q1 FY27 earnings deck (guidance table): https://s21.q4cdn.com/328470014/files/doc_financials/2027/q1/BOX-Earnings-DECK-Q1FY27-Q4website.pdf
- Q2 FY27 earnings deck: https://s21.q4cdn.com/328470014/files/doc_earnings/2027/q2/presentation/Earnings-DECK-Q2FY27.pdf
